name: memkind
description: User-extensible heap manager built on jemalloc that enables control of memory characteristics and partitioning of the heap between kinds of memory

daxctl.description: Enable automatic DEVDAX and DAX KMEM recognition through libdaxctl from ndctl (requires libdaxctl 66 or newer)

hwloc.description: Enable HMAT memory attribute support through hwloc (requires hwloc 2.3 or newer)
